title: Tower category has enough injectives
statement: The abelian category [lem-pc-tower-abelian] of inverse systems of abelian groups indexed by the natural numbers has enough injective objects [def-sp-enough-injectives].

proof.text: For a tower $A=(A_n,f_n)$, [lem-pc-tower-injective-embedding] gives a monomorphism $A\to I$ in the abelian tower category [lem-pc-tower-abelian] such that each $I_n$ is an injective abelian group and each transition map $p_n:I_{n+1}\to I_n$ is a split surjection.

Such a tower $I$ is an injective object [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of the tower category. Let $A\to B$ be a monomorphism of towers, with transition maps $f_n$ of $A$ and $g_n$ of $B$, and let $\varphi:A\to I$ be a morphism. Since kernels in the tower category [lem-pc-tower-abelian] are computed levelwise, each $A_n\to B_n$ is injective. Extend $\varphi_1$ to $\psi_1:B_1\to I_1$ by injectivity of $I_1$. If $\psi_n:B_n\to I_n$ extends $\varphi_n$ and is compatible with the transitions up to level $n$, let $s_n$ be a section of $p_n$. On $A_{n+1}$ the map $\varphi_{n+1}-s_n\psi_ng_n=\varphi_{n+1}-s_n\varphi_nf_n$ satisfies $p_n(\varphi_{n+1}-s_n\varphi_nf_n)=\varphi_nf_n-\varphi_nf_n=0$, so it lands in $\ker(p_n)$, which is injective as a direct summand of the injective group $I_{n+1}$; extend it to $\chi:B_{n+1}\to\ker(p_n)$. Then $\psi_{n+1}=\chi+s_n\psi_ng_n$ extends $\varphi_{n+1}$ and satisfies $p_n\psi_{n+1}=\psi_ng_n$. The $\psi_n$ form a morphism $B\to I$ extending $\varphi$, so $I$ is injective. Thus every tower embeds in an injective tower, which is [def-sp-enough-injectives].
